title: Goal relevance shapes the behavioral impact of facial emotions: A meta-analysis
title_zh: 目标相关性塑造面部情绪的行为影响：一项元分析
abstract: Emotionally charged stimuli can significantly influence behavior, yet it remains unclear why they do so in some contexts but not in others. A growing body of evidence provides strong empirical evidence that the impact of emotional stimuli depends on their relevance to current task demands. This perspective challenges earlier views proposing automatic behavioral responses to emotional stimuli and complements contemporary accounts emphasizing privileged emotional processing by suggesting that emotional information influences behavior primarily when it is relevant to current goals. To assess this account, we conducted a PRISMA-compliant meta-analysis, examining how emotional facial expressions influence reactive inhibitory control in the Stop-Signal and Go/No-Go task (indexed by stop-signal reaction time and commission errors, respectively) and response readiness in the Go/No-Go task (indexed by reaction times and omission errors) in healthy young adults, as a function of goal relevance. Goal relevance was tested as a categorical moderator across emotional contrasts and behavioral outcomes. Results showed that emotional valence reliably modulated inhibitory control and response readiness when emotional information was required for response selection but produced little or no systematic behavioral effects when it was task-irrelevant. Within-subject studies yielded the most robust effects, likely reflecting greater statistical power and reduced inter-individual variability. No consistent evidence of publication bias was detected. These findings support a goal-directed account of emotion-action interactions and suggest that enhanced neural processing of emotional stimuli does not necessarily translate into behavioral effects. Rather, emotional information appears to influence action primarily when it is relevant to the current goals.
abstract_zh: 情绪性刺激能够显著影响行为，但为何在某些情境下会起作用而在其他情境下不起作用一直不清楚。越来越多的证据表明，情绪刺激的行为影响取决于其与当前任务需求的相关性。该观点挑战了早期“情绪刺激会自动触发行为反应”的观点，并与当代理论中强调特权化情绪加工的观点相补充，认为情绪信息主要在与当前目标相关时才会影响行为。为检验这一观点，我们进行了一项符合PRISMA规范的元分析，考察了情绪面部表情在停顿信号任务和Go/No-Go任务中对反应性抑制控制（分别以停顿信号反应时和错误抑制失误为指标）以及Go/No-Go任务中反应准备（以反应时和漏检失误为指标）的影响，研究对象为健康青年，按目标相关性进行分组。目标相关性被作为情绪对照与行为结局之间的类别调节变量进行检验。结果显示，当情绪信息是反应选择所必需时，情绪价度可可靠调节抑制控制和反应准备；但当情绪信息与任务无关时，对行为的影响很小或缺乏系统性。被试内研究产生了最稳健的效应，可能反映更高统计效能和更低个体间变异。未发现稳定的发表偏倚证据。上述发现支持目标导向的情绪-行动相互作用框架，提示增强的情绪刺激神经加工并不必然转化为行为效应；情绪信息似乎主要在与当前目标相关时才影响行动。
